# Force-Field Fixtures

The four MMFF SMILES files are byte-for-byte copies from RDKit `2026.03.1`,
revision `351f8f378f8ad6bbd517980c38896e66bf907af8c`. The suite selects all four
upstream dative/hypervalent variants and does not filter rows at test time.

The copied files retain RDKit's BSD-3-Clause license context.
`source_manifest.jsonl` records each upstream path, byte length, and SHA-256.
